# Good Coconut 好好椰

Coconut drinks, coconut pudding and egg waffles in New York City. Two shops:

## Good Coconut Flushing (Flushing, Queens)

- Phone: (917) 285-2287
- Menu: https://good-coconut.vercel.app/menu/

- Delivery (DoorDash): https://www.doordash.com/store/good-coconut-flushing-31799419/
